headline: Northwind Logistics opens automated cross-dock hub in Hamburg port
summary: The forwarder invested EUR 40m in a new hub that doubles its handling capacity for Baltic routes.

headline: Northwind named carrier of the year by German retail association
summary: Retail association cites on-time delivery above 98 percent across 2025.

headline: Helios Components confirms breach of customer order portal
summary: Attackers accessed order histories and contact details for roughly 12,000 business customers before the portal was taken offline.

headline: ICO opens investigation into Helios Components data breach
summary: The regulator is reviewing whether Helios met its security obligations under UK GDPR.

headline: Helios wins multi-year supply contract with rail signalling group
summary: The contract covers connectors and harnesses for signalling upgrades.

headline: Customs seize Corvane-chartered cargo over export control concerns
summary: Dual-use machine tools bound for a third country were held at Constanta pending investigation.

headline: Corvane owner linked to sanctioned network, report says
summary: An investigative report connects Corvane's majority owner to entities designated in 2024.

headline: Atlas Cloud completes SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 recertification
summary: Auditors reported no exceptions for the 2025-2026 period.

headline: Atlas Cloud adds Frankfurt region for EU data residency
summary: The region gives European customers in-country hosting and support.

headline: Spanish regulator fines Meridian Pharma over manufacturing lapses
summary: AEMPS imposed a EUR 2.1m penalty after inspectors found repeated GMP deviations at the Getafe plant.

headline: Meridian recalls two batches of generic blood-pressure medication
summary: The recall follows out-of-specification impurity results; no patient harm has been reported.

headline: Bluefin Analytics raises GBP 8m Series A
summary: The consultancy will expand its retail forecasting practice.

headline: Orion Freight files for Chapter 7 after losing anchor customer
summary: The trucking company ceased operations and laid off 140 drivers.

headline: Drivers sue Orion Freight over unpaid wages
summary: A class action alleges misclassification and $3.4m in unpaid overtime.

headline: Estonian FIU reviews crypto payment processors after licensing overhaul
summary: Quantum Ledger is among 14 firms asked to re-file AML documentation.

headline: Lumen Health Partners expands nurse staffing to Georgia hospitals
summary: The expansion adds 300 contracted clinicians across six hospitals.
